//: sentinel config. All bot names below are FICTIONAL examples. Keys starting with // are comments and are ignored by the loader/validator.
// service_accounts: Machine accounts whose user.type is 'User' (not 'Bot') but which should still be treated as bots. Detection via user.type == 'Bot' alone misses these.
// escalate_globs: Findings whose file path matches any of these globs are ALWAYS routed to the human, even when the bot's policy is auto_address. Use for safety-critical paths.
// max_iterations: THE authoritative cap on fix-push-rescan rounds. A round is any scan that produced news (fixable findings or escalations); no-news polling rounds are free. On the cap the loop parks and escalates everything still open, blocking findings first. Not to be confused with SENTINEL_AUTOSCAN_MAX_ROUNDS, which is how many times the hook polls for one commit's comments.
// blocking_severities: Severity tokens the loop may not converge past, matched case/separator-insensitively as whole tokens. Overridable per bot. A per-bot list REPLACES this one rather than adding to it. 'unknown' is rejected: it is sentinel's own unparsed-severity sentinel.
// human_threads: GraphQL reviewThreads classification of HUMAN review-thread conversations (REST alone cannot see thread resolution/outdated state). Human-rooted threads always escalate (never auto-answered) until resolved; outdated-but-unresolved still escalates, it is never dropped. Default ON; set enabled:false to fall back to bot-comments-only scanning (e.g. no GraphQL access).

bots.//: A sticky-comment review bot. It posts under the SHARED github-actions[bot] login, so it must be disambiguated by a stable HTML-comment marker in the body.
bots.name: review-bot
bots.// policy: auto_address: the agent fixes root causes and pushes; the push IS the reply. This bot re-reviews every push and never reads comment replies.
bots.// severity_patterns: Regexes (first capture group = severity) tried in order against finding lines in the body.
bots.// clean_phrases: If the bot's most recent comment contains any of these substrings, the bot is considered converged.
bots.// feedback_checkbox: This bot exposes a checkbox on its sticky comment to flag inaccurate findings; the agent ticks it instead of replying.
bots.// drip_feed: This bot reveals roughly one new finding per push. sentinel warns the agent to expect more findings after the next push.

bots.//: An inline review-comment bot with its own dedicated login and a reply channel: it responds to @-mentions.
bots.name: lintbot
bots.// reply_channel: Mention handle to use if the agent needs to talk back to this bot (e.g. to ask for a re-run or dispute a finding).

bots.//: A coverage-report service account: user.type is 'User', listed in service_accounts above. Pure FYI, so policy ignore.
bots.name: coverage-svc

bots.//: A bundle-size FYI bot sharing the github-actions[bot] login; disambiguated by its own marker; ignored.
bots.name: bundlewatch

bots.//: A security scanner. Its findings are never auto-addressed: policy escalate routes everything verbatim to the human.
bots.name: seccomb-scan
